sv.title: Analytikerna: Så mycket faller SKF-aktien i dag
sv.summary: På torsdagen handlas kullagerföretaget SKF exklusive rätt att erhålla aktier i fordonsverksamheten SKF Vertevo som knoppas av och planeras att noteras på Stockholmsbörsen den 1 december.

en.title: Analysts: This is how much the SKF share falls today
en.summary: On Thursday, the bearings company SKF trades ex-rights to receive shares in its vehicle business SKF Vertevo, which is being spun off and is planned to be listed on the Stockholm Stock Exchange on 1 December.
